newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia trade deficit falls in first 7 months.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia trade deficit falls in first 7 months.

text.p: Tunisia's trade deficit in the first seven months of 1996 fell to 1.29 billion dinars from 1.33 billion in the same period last year, official statistics show.
Exports totalled 3.06 billion, up 1.3 percent from 3.02 billion, while imports were broadly unchanged at 4.35 billion.
Manufactured exports, excluding food products, rose by 7.2 percent, with the main gains in textiles and the electrical and chemical sectors. ($=0.96 dinar)
